allowedResources: A Python 3.12 environment with the pinned packages in starter/requirements.txt (FastAPI, httpx, pydantic and pytest), set up before the timed work; no payments service, database, Docker, network or AI service is needed
Any further resource rule (course pages, documentation, notes) is set and shown by the platform assessment owner
instructions: Final Assessment coding challenge, Python/FastAPI (intermediate, 20 minutes from the end of setup, reading included). Add the POST /refunds route to starter/refunds/main.py: look the payment up with the provided client, map its errors to 404/504/502, refuse an uncaptured payment or a refund beyond this payment's captured amount with 409, otherwise store the refund and answer 201 with only the RefundOut fields; a refused refund is never stored. Run python -m pytest -q; the score is the share of the 9 checks that pass, pass mark 70%.
